description: Prepare a change to the user's connected account as a DRY RUN: nothing is written. AppGoat reads the live account and returns the before → after diff, guardrail results (AI probabilities for store policy, tone and risky claims, plus checks such as character limits and bid jumps) and an action id. ALWAYS show the diff and any guardrail flags to the user and get their go-ahead before calling apply_action. Types and params (app = a linked App Store id or package name, locale like en-US): review.reply {app, review_id, text} (review ids from read_connection what=reviews; Play replies ≤ 350 chars); listing.update {app, locale, fields: {name|title, subtitle, description, promotional_text, whats_new, marketing_url, support_url, privacy_policy_url}} (Play: title, short_description, full_description, video); keywords.set {app, locale, keywords: [..] or 'a,b,c', mode?: replace|add|remove} (App Store, 100 bytes comma-joined); screenshots.upload {app, locale, display_type: APP_IPHONE_67… (asc) or image_type: phoneScreenshots… (play), images: [{url}], replace?}; apple_ads.keyword.bid {campaign_id, ad_group_id, keywords: [{id, bid?, status?: ENABLED|PAUSED}], max_increase?}; apple_ads.keyword.add {campaign_id, ad_group_id, keywords: [{text, match_type?: EXACT|BROAD, bid?}]}; apple_ads.negative.add {campaign_id, ad_group_id?, keywords: [{text, match_type?}]}; apple_ads.campaign.create {app, name, countries: ['US'], daily_budget, placement?: APPSTORE_SEARCH_RESULTS (default)|APPSTORE_SEARCH_TAB|APPSTORE_TODAY_TAB|APPSTORE_PRODUCT_PAGES, max_daily_budget?} (manual CPT in the ad account currency; always created PAUSED); apple_ads.campaign.update {campaign_id, status?: ENABLED|PAUSED, daily_budget?, countries?, name?}; apple_ads.adgroup.create {campaign_id, name, default_bid, search_match?: false, status?, start_time?}; apple_ads.adgroup.update {campaign_id, ad_group_id, status?, default_bid?, search_match?, name?} (Apple Ads ids from read_connection what=ads). Apple Ads changes that can raise spend (enabling a campaign or ad group, a higher budget or default bid, new countries, Search Match on) are marked 'can raise ad spend': apply them only on the user's explicit go-ahead. Cost: 0 credits.

connection.description: Connection id from list_connections; optional when exactly one active connection fits the type and app

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

playbook.description: The playbook proposing this, e.g. 'reply-to-every-review' (shown to approvers); omit outside a playbook
